purpose: Classify local restriction compatibility and distinguish generator-local from higher gluing obstructions inside KuuOS dependent-origination descent sectors.

restriction_semantics.restriction_compatible: Every bounded comparison inside one conditioning family is locally compatible.
restriction_semantics.restriction_held: At least one bounded comparison inside one conditioning family is unresolved.
restriction_semantics.restriction_obstructed: A bounded comparison inside one conditioning family is explicitly incompatible.
restriction_semantics.restriction_trivial: The restricted presentation has fewer than two representatives.

sector_diagnoses.restriction_stable_descent: A descended v7.4 sector remains locally compatible on every conditioning-family restriction.
sector_diagnoses.generator_local_obstruction: At least one generating conditioning family is already locally obstructed.
sector_diagnoses.higher_gluing_obstruction: All generating conditioning-family restrictions are locally compatible, yet the generated presentation class is globally obstructed.
sector_diagnoses.local_restriction_unresolved: At least one generating conditioning-family restriction is unresolved.
sector_diagnoses.higher_gluing_unresolved: All generator restrictions are resolved locally, but the transitive presentation class remains unresolved.
sector_diagnoses.local_only_no_restriction: An isolated local presentation has no nontrivial conditioning-family restriction.

descent.next: higher local coherence candidates over overlapping conditioning families, still without replacing Lean theorem authority
